name: Thai 2 Go
kurzbeschreibung:
**Thai 2 Go in Tirol** Discover the vibrant flavors of Thailand right in the heart of the **Alps**! At **Thai 2 Go**, we bring the taste of **Bangkok** to **Tirol**, serving up authentic Thai cuisine with a touch of local charm. Our menu features all-time favorites like **Pad Thai**, **Green Curry**, and **Som Tam**, but with a twist—because even in the mountains, you deserve a taste of the exotic. **Visit us in:** - **Innsbruck** – Your gateway to Thai flavors in the city - **Kufstein** – A cozy stop on your journey through **Tirol** - **Lienz** – Where the East meets the West Whether you're craving a quick bite after a day of hiking or a full meal to unwind, **Thai 2 Go** delivers fresh, delicious, and satisfying dishes. **Come taste the world—one bite at a time!** --- **

Our Highlights:

** - **Kaiserschmarrn** with Thai-inspired toppings (yes, you read that right!) - **Massaman Curry**—rich, tender, and perfect for sharing - **Mango Sticky Rice**—sweet, creamy, and irresistibly good **

Open daily—because good food shouldn’t wait!
